$comment: SOLUSDEV-220 (CTR-05) — the ONE definition of 'this text is about a design, not about a tool'. Loaded by packages/shared-types/src/tool-knowledge.ts AND packages/api/src/solus_api/contracts/tool_knowledge.py. Two hand-maintained copies of a security filter drifted within one ticket (the TS list was missing AWG); this file is why that cannot happen again. Patterns are restricted to the syntax JS and Python regex engines share. Text is NFKC-normalised before matching, so homoglyphs do not evade these. Every pattern here matches a MECHANICAL shape (path, id, file, URL, dimensioned value, reference designator). Prose naming a customer's part — 'Hero Arm Bracket Rev C' — is NOT and cannot be caught here; two patterns that tried were removed because they rejected KiCad's own 'Net Label' menu item and 'Revision History'. THIS LIST IS A BACKSTOP, NOT A FILTER — see docs/contracts/tool-knowledge.md 'What this contract does not do'.

patterns.why: looks like a path or an assembly hierarchy
looks like an Onshape document, workspace or element id
contains a long opaque hex id
looks like a schematic reference designator
